description: Industrielles Abwasser NRW - Direkt- / Indirekteinleitende Betriebe, Abwasserbehandlungsanlagen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by LANUK NRW. In North Rhine-Westphalia, data on the wastewater treatment of industrial and commercial dischargers are collected by the competent water authorities (district governments, lower water authorities) in the ELKA database (initiator register). These are master data and the type of treatment. Coverage: LANUK NRW. The portal shows the English title as "Industrial wastewater NRW - direct / indirect initiating plants, wastewater treatment plants" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is LANUK NRW. Its keywords include Abwasserbehandlungsanlagen, gewerbliche Einleiter, Indirekteinleiter, Einleitungsstellen, Abwasser, ELKA. The listing shows 2026-03-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
